frequency_hz.note: X-band airborne reconnaissance SAR operating frequency (exact frequency unpublished)

bandwidth_hz.note: Chirp bandwidth consistent with sub-meter slant-range resolution c/(2B) ~ 0.5 m (Curlander & McDonough Ch. 2)

power_w.note: Unpublished average SAR transmit power; U-2S long-standoff reconnaissance class estimate

peak_power_w.note: Unpublished peak SAR transmit power (~10% duty cycle class estimate)

peak_gain_dbi.note: Unpublished side-looking phased/slotted SAR antenna peak gain (U-2S nose array class)

noise_figure_db.note: Typical X-band airborne SAR receiver noise figure

system_loss_db.note: Radome, waveguide, and SAR azimuth/range processing losses (assumed)

finest_resolution_m.note: Assumed finest spotlight SAR resolution class (exact performance classified)

range_min_m.note: Minimum slant range for side-looking grazing geometry from high altitude

range_max_m.note: Assumed high-altitude standoff SAR imaging envelope (~220 km from 18-21 km MSL)

curlander-sar.title: J. C. Curlander & R. N. McDonough, Synthetic Aperture Radar: Systems and Signal Processing (Wiley, 1991)
